captions.detailed: A compact drill vise featuring a dark gray tilting base with side trunnions, a sliding front jaw, and a front handwheel. The front jaw slides prismatically along the top guide, while the light gray handwheel is designed to rotate continuously on its screw axis. The entire upper vise body tilts on a horizontal trunnion joint relative to the stationary base plate.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact drill vise with a tilting base, a sliding front jaw, and a front handwheel. The handwheel should rotate continuously, the jaw should slide prismatically, and the upper body should tilt on a side trunnion relative to the base, using dark and light gray materials.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a fixed base plate. It defines a tilting body connected via a revolute joint to simulate the side trunnion. On top of this tilting body, a sliding jaw is added using a prismatic joint. Finally, a handwheel is modeled with a continuous joint representing the screw axis, with all parts built from box and cylinder primitives.
